def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The lattice lines are the rows/columns that are predominantly the

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v != 9 for v in grid[r]) > w // 2]

    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return []

    sep = Counter(v for r in row_lines for v in grid[r] if v != 9).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in col_lines] for r in row_lines]
    marked = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(nodes) for j, v in enumerate(row)
              if v != 9 and v != sep]
    if not marked:
        return []
    r0 = min(i for i, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(j for _, j in marked)
    c1 = max(j for _, j in marked)

    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):

            color, n = counts.most_common(1)[0] if counts else (9, 0)

def transform(grid):
    # Infer the grid's line and node structure from the background-filled cells.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x != 9 for x in grid[r]) > w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(h)) > h // 2]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    # Return the colored-node bounding pattern, consolidating each adjacent
    # 2x2 node block by its repeated non-background color.
    bg = Counter(x for row in nodes for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(nodes) for j, x in enumerate(row) if x not in (bg, 9)]
    if not marked:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(i for i, _ in marked), max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(j for _, j in marked), max(j for _, j in marked)
    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        line = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            vals = [nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j+1], nodes[i+1][j], nodes[i+1][j+1]]
            cnt = Counter(v for v in vals if v not in (bg, 9))
            color, n = cnt.most_common(1)[0] if cnt else (9, 0)
            line.append(color if n >= 3 else 9)
        out.append(line)
